note: Traditional dance associated with a community and passed across generations; forms and meanings vary by culture.

senses.m: Traditional dance associated with a community and passed across generations
senses.pat: perform a folk dance · traditional folk dance · folk-dance group
ex: The troupe performed a folk dance from the region.
Đoàn nghệ thuật biểu diễn một điệu múa dân gian của vùng.
The festival included music and folk dancing.
Lễ hội có âm nhạc và các tiết mục múa dân gian.

note: Music rooted in a community’s tradition, often passed on orally; also a modern singer-songwriter genre.

senses.m: Music rooted in a community’s tradition, often passed on orally
senses.pat: traditional folk music · folk-music festival · folk music from Ireland
ex: They recorded folk music from several villages.
Họ thu âm nhạc dân gian từ một số ngôi làng.
The singer blends folk music with electronic sounds.
Ca sĩ kết hợp nhạc folk với âm thanh điện tử.

note: A singer who performs traditional or contemporary folk music.

senses.m: A singer who performs traditional or contemporary folk music
senses.pat: a folk singer performs · become a folk singer · popular folk singer
ex: The folk singer accompanied herself on guitar.
Ca sĩ nhạc folk tự đệm đàn guitar.
She became a folk singer after moving to the city.
Cô trở thành ca sĩ nhạc folk sau khi chuyển đến thành phố.

note: A song originating in or associated with a community’s folk tradition; many have multiple oral versions.

senses.m: A song originating in or associated with a community’s folk tradition
senses.pat: sing a folk song · traditional folk song · collect folk songs
ex: The children learned a folk song from their grandparents.
Bọn trẻ học một bài dân ca từ ông bà.
Researchers documented several versions of the song.
Các nhà nghiên cứu ghi chép nhiều dị bản của bài hát.

note: A traditional story passed down in a community, often with magical or moral elements.

senses.m: A traditional story passed down in a community, often with magical or moral elements
senses.pat: tell/read a folk tale · traditional folk tale · folk-tale collection
ex: The book retells a folk tale about a clever rabbit.
Cuốn sách kể lại truyện dân gian về một con thỏ khôn ngoan.
Many folk tales explain how a place got its name.
Nhiều truyện dân gian giải thích nguồn gốc tên một địa danh.

note: An emergency landing because an aircraft cannot continue safely; the aircraft may or may not be damaged.

senses.m: An emergency landing because an aircraft cannot continue safely
senses.pat: make a forced landing · forced landing at sea · survive a forced landing
ex: The pilot made a forced landing in a field after an engine warning.
Phi công hạ cánh bắt buộc xuống cánh đồng sau cảnh báo động cơ.
All passengers were safe after the forced landing.
Tất cả hành khách đều an toàn sau lần hạ cánh khẩn cấp.

note: A crisp folded cookie with a paper message, commonly served in Chinese restaurants in North America; not a traditional Chinese dessert in many contexts.

senses.m: A crisp folded cookie with a paper message, commonly served in Chinese restaurants in North America
senses.pat: open a fortune cookie · message inside a fortune cookie · fortune-cookie slip
ex: She opened the fortune cookie and read the message aloud.
Cô bẻ chiếc bánh may mắn và đọc mẩu giấy thành tiếng.
The fortune cookie predicted a new opportunity.
Mẩu giấy trong bánh may mắn dự báo một cơ hội mới.

note: Someone seeking wealth or a rich marriage partner, often implying self-interest; can sound disapproving.

senses.m: Someone seeking wealth or a rich marriage partner, often implying self-interest
senses.pat: a fortune hunter seeks · call someone a fortune hunter · marry a fortune hunter
ex: The novel portrays him as a fortune hunter pursuing an heiress.
Tiểu thuyết khắc họa anh là kẻ đào mỏ theo đuổi nữ thừa kế.
She rejected the label and built her own business.
Cô bác bỏ lời gán đó và tự xây dựng doanh nghiệp.

note: Illegal, violent, or dishonest behavior; used when suspicious circumstances suggest a crime.

senses.m: Illegal, violent, or dishonest behavior
senses.pat: suspect foul play · rule out foul play · evidence of foul play
ex: Police found no evidence of foul play.
Cảnh sát không tìm thấy bằng chứng về hành vi phạm pháp.
The unexplained damage led investigators to suspect foul play.
Thiệt hại không rõ nguyên nhân khiến điều tra viên nghi có hành vi phá hoại.

note: To make a mistake that disrupts something; informal, often foul something up.

senses.m: To make a mistake that disrupts something
senses.pat: foul up the schedule · foul something up badly · get fouled up
ex: A data-entry error fouled up the delivery schedule.
Lỗi nhập dữ liệu làm rối lịch giao hàng.
I fouled up the directions and we took the wrong road.
Tôi chỉ đường sai nên chúng tôi đi nhầm đường.

note: A stone laid at a building’s base, often ceremonially; figuratively a basic principle or starting point.

senses.m: A stone laid at a building’s base, often ceremonially
senses.pat: lay the foundation stone · foundation-stone ceremony · foundation stone of
ex: The mayor laid the foundation stone for the new library.
Thị trưởng đặt viên đá nền cho thư viện mới.
Trust is the foundation stone of a lasting partnership.
Lòng tin là nền tảng của quan hệ hợp tác bền vững.

note: Speaking or writing whatever comes to mind without deliberate censorship, used in psychoanalysis and creative work.

senses.m: Speaking or writing whatever comes to mind without deliberate censorship, used in psychoanalysis and creative work
senses.pat: use free association · free-association exercise · speak by free association
ex: The therapist invited the patient to speak through free association.
Nhà trị liệu đề nghị bệnh nhân nói theo dòng liên tưởng tự do.
The writing exercise began with ten minutes of free association.
Bài tập viết bắt đầu bằng mười phút viết theo liên tưởng tự do.

note: A person fighting against what they regard as oppressive rule; approving and politically contested, while opponents may say rebel or insurgent.

senses.m: A person fighting against what they regard as oppressive rule
senses.pat: be hailed as a freedom fighter · freedom-fighter movement · national freedom fighters
ex: Supporters remembered her as a freedom fighter.
Những người ủng hộ nhớ đến bà như một chiến sĩ đấu tranh cho tự do.
The textbook notes that the label is politically contested.
Sách giáo khoa lưu ý nhãn gọi này gây tranh cãi chính trị.

note: To deliberately exclude someone from a group or activity; also force a competitor out of a market.

senses.m: To deliberately exclude someone from a group or activity
senses.pat: freeze someone out of a meeting · be frozen out · freeze out a rival
ex: He felt frozen out of important decisions.
Anh cảm thấy bị gạt khỏi các quyết định quan trọng.
The larger firm used discounts to freeze out smaller competitors.
Công ty lớn dùng giảm giá để ép đối thủ nhỏ rời thị trường.

note: Salad dressing with regional meanings: often sweet and tomato-based in the US, vinaigrette-style in Britain.

senses.m: Salad dressing with regional meanings: often sweet and tomato-based in the US, vinaigrette-style in Britain
senses.pat: serve French dressing · bottle of French dressing · French-dressed salad
ex: In the US, French dressing is often orange and slightly sweet.
Ở Mỹ, sốt French dressing thường màu cam và hơi ngọt.
In Britain, French dressing may mean a simple vinaigrette.
Ở Anh, French dressing có thể chỉ xốt giấm dầu đơn giản.

note: Accidental firing on or attack of one’s own forces; a military term that does not imply friendly intent.

senses.m: Accidental firing on or attack of one’s own forces
senses.pat: killed/wounded by friendly fire · friendly-fire incident · casualties from friendly fire
ex: The report confirmed that the unit was hit by friendly fire.
Báo cáo xác nhận đơn vị bị trúng hỏa lực quân mình.
The army opened an inquiry into the incident.
Quân đội mở cuộc điều tra về vụ việc.

note: Cake containing dried or candied fruit, often nuts; informally can describe an eccentric person and may insult.

senses.m: Cake containing dried or candied fruit, often nuts
senses.pat: a slice of fruit cake · bake a fruit cake · call someone a fruitcake
ex: They served fruit cake with tea.
Họ dùng bánh trái cây với trà.
The writer called the proposal fruitcake, which sounded dismissive.
Tác giả gọi đề xuất đó là ngớ ngẩn, nghe có vẻ coi thường.

note: A small fly attracted to ripe or fermenting fruit; some species damage crops, while others are used in research.

senses.m: A small fly attracted to ripe or fermenting fruit
senses.pat: fruit-fly infestation · fruit-fly trap · fruit flies around bananas
ex: Fruit flies gathered around the overripe peaches.
Ruồi giấm bu quanh những quả đào quá chín.
Researchers use fruit flies to study genetics.
Các nhà nghiên cứu dùng ruồi giấm để nghiên cứu di truyền.

note: A dish of mixed fruit cut into pieces; figuratively, a mixture of unrelated elements.

senses.m: A dish of mixed fruit cut into pieces
senses.pat: make/serve fruit salad · bowl of fruit salad · fruit-salad dressing
ex: She brought a bowl of fruit salad to the picnic.
Cô mang một tô trái cây trộn đến buổi dã ngoại.
The design looked like a fruit salad of clashing colors.
Thiết kế trông như hỗn hợp lộn xộn những màu sắc xung khắc.

note: An electrochemical device converting fuel and oxidant into electricity; hydrogen-cell emissions depend on how the hydrogen is produced.

senses.m: An electrochemical device converting fuel and oxidant into electricity
senses.pat: hydrogen fuel cell · fuel-cell technology · power a vehicle with fuel cells
ex: The bus uses a hydrogen fuel cell for electric power.
Xe buýt dùng pin nhiên liệu hydro để tạo điện.
The project will test fuel cells for backup power.
Dự án sẽ thử nghiệm pin nhiên liệu làm nguồn điện dự phòng.
